sideB.text:
Recon North America.

Add this card to your pool of objectives.
If you complete it, but lose the first game in January, it counts as complete during your second game in January!

mechanics.whenRead: The second January mandatory objective, drawn with 01-04 after 01-03.
rules: Add this card to the pool of objectives.
If you complete it but lose the first game in January, it still counts as complete during the second game in January.
mechanics.notes: Side A is the objective-card back. The objective name and the two small sentences are printed vertically on side B.
